A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same V-SEAM study. Their complete main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A-I support reliable comparison despite bibliographic updates and page reflow.

before.justification: v1 reports original activation-patching, attention-head editing, and VQA experiments with LLaVA and InstructBLIP on GQA, POPE, and COCOQA, including extensive appendix results.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and their numerical and qualitative outcomes in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: Section 4 retains identical semantic editing, activation patching, attention-head identification, and embedding-rescaling procedures. No method component, input, or inference operation changes.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same seven GQA semantic subtasks, three POPE subsets, and COCOQA color, object, and location tasks. Appendices B and G retain the same coverage.

E2.justification: Tables 3 and 17 retain original, positive-head removal, negative-head removal, and random-removal comparisons. Appendix C retains the same Gaussian noise, salt-and-pepper noise, masking, and diffusion comparators.

E3.justification: Model configurations, the 12,647-question GQA sample, filtering, prompts, metrics, and subsampling/evaluation procedures match. The changed citation year beside LLaVA 1.5 7B does not change the stated model.

E4.justification: Head-removal ablations, data-dependence tests, transfer evaluations, perturbation comparisons, Logit Lens cases, activation-patching analyses, and attention-overlap analyses are retained unchanged, including their appendix evidence.

E5.justification: Both versions report ten repetitions for data-dependence experiments and 1,000 bootstrap folds of 100 cases for paired t-tests. Appendix H and Table 18 retain identical uncertainty and significance reporting.

E6.justification: Matched numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, Table 3 retains rescaled average accuracies of 89.48% for LLaVA and 91.65% for InstructBLIP; appendix results also match.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and Equations (1)-(10), including patching effects, head scores, normalization, and rescaling, are unchanged. No formal assumption, derivation, or proof is added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about semantic intervention, attention/MLP roles, positive and negative heads, and VQA improvements.

C2.justification: Mechanistic interpretations and applicability claims are retained. The limitations concerning binary questions, computationally costly patching, and unresolved attention-head interactions are also unchanged.

D1.justification: Prompt templates, filtering instructions, editing tools, code/data access information, and Appendix I's hardware and software disclosures are unchanged. Reflowed appendix passages provide no new implementation details.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion and research positioning remain unchanged. References match across revised author lists, titles, identifiers, and publication metadata; these are bibliographic updates to retained works.

P1.justification: v2 revises multiple bibliographic entries and corresponding citation years, updates the arXiv version/date text, and shortens Table 7's caption. Main scientific prose and section order remain unchanged.

P2.justification: All 14 figures and 24 tables are retained. The shorter Table 7 caption slightly changes its placement, while expanded references reflow subsequent appendix text without adding or removing displays.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves reference traceability. For example, the incomplete 'From redundancy to relevance' entry ending with 'pages arXiv-2406' becomes a full 2025 proceedings citation with pages 2289-2299, and other references gain publication details. These limited documentation gains leave the scientific methods, evidence, and limitations unchanged.
